title: A small place for careful listening

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.en: Welcome to Listening Desk, a small place for slow and careful listening.
segments.zh: 欢迎来到听译台，一个适合慢下来、认真聆听的小空间。

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.en: A podcast can carry an idea across the world in a single afternoon.
segments.zh: 一档播客可以在一个下午，把一种思想带到世界另一端。

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.en: But language often stands between the speaker and the listener.
segments.zh: 但语言往往隔在讲述者与听众之间。

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.en: This player keeps the original sentence and its Chinese translation together.
segments.zh: 这个播放器让英文原句与中文翻译始终并排呈现。

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.en: As the voice moves forward, the current passage follows the playback head.
segments.zh: 随着声音向前，当前字幕会跟随播放进度移动。

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.en: You can select any sentence to return to that exact moment.
segments.zh: 你可以点击任意一句，回到它出现的准确时刻。

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.en: Import your own episode when you are ready to begin.
segments.zh: 准备好之后，就导入你自己的播客开始吧。
